snippet.title: Cranked Prototype Gameplay - PC Mountain Bike Game
snippet.description:
Check out some raw gameplay footage of the Cranked prototype. This was developed by a small indie team of four over two months. Still a lot of work to do, but we couldn't wait any longer to show you some gameplay!

If you want to get development builds and help us test then join our Patreon community here: https://www.patreon.com/CrankedGame?utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator

Discord: https://discord.gg/QHHRBfBck2
